title: Kishiwada Castle

buildingCutout.basis: Named main keep footprint atop its surveyed stone foundation.

terrainReference.basis: Original grade on the inside of the fortified ward near the principal keep.

mapIdentity.scope: Named native keeps, separately drawn adjacent walls and moat shore, official city reconstruction records, and cleared photographs from both visible faces.

note: A three-tiered white keep with black tile roofs and a smaller linked tower. Battered masonry rises from the moat to capped perimeter walls. The 1969 gate and corner ranges are retained.
